notes.title: New sailing location! "Lake in Japan"
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/2c56127efa849533acd66ec5aab81db919d88cc4.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/979340/VR_Regatta__Lake_in_Japan/

Lake in Japan is the first expansion pack for VR Regatta. Relax and discover new places on your own sailboat!

[h1]Features[/h1]

[list]
[*] A huge lake surrounded by mountains waiting to be explored 
[*] Unique Japanese setting - feel like you are on holidays discovering the world 
[*] Relaxing mode - Sail around the lake at your own pace 
[*] Optional races with on-line leader-boards
[/list]

More details and discussion here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/1752358461540027778/

notes.title: Home Sailing - 1.1 release has shipped!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/2cb1767847499eee8e1132796b11200ef672f48b.gif[/img]

[h1]Ahoy![/h1] 
VR Regatta 1.1 has shipped! 

With this release VR Regatta is also [b]available on Oculus Home[/b].. and this means more sailors to interact with in Multiplayer ( which is cross-platform! :-) ) and compete in Daily Races.

[h1]Discover sailing[/h1]
Interested in learning how to sail? Never sailed before? Watch these first timers sail in VR Regatta:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LtrzRH6XZ60
[h1]Easter eggs[/h1]
What easter eggs in VR Regatta have you found? Here is [url=https://twitter.com/MarineVerseVR/status/1040151781370519553]one to give you an example[/url] :-)
[h1]Speedruns [/h1]
How quickly can your progress from Landsman to Able Seaman? Watch Greg completing this challenge: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=okk1LSIrHpo
Post your runs here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/1743346190280040174/

[h1]Happy sailing[/h1]
Remember to join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/H5Kxxcf 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/bc112073cbcd37d6d94da31ea6c4279ee14962ea.gif[/img]
Thank you for being part of VR Regatta community! 

Greg

notes.title: Smooth sailing - 1.1beta patch notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25032507/57da4c459fe89f1842dde1b52d974e1efa2599bc.gif[/img]
Ahoy!

VR Regatta 1.1beta has just shipped with some major engine improvements and bug fixes!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
    [*] [b]Performance optimizations[/b] - We've optimized the game in various places and overall it should run much smoother.
    [*] Fixed minor issues with 3D text in levels 
    [*] Ability to setup private [url=https://www.marineverse.com/vr-regatta/events/test-event]"Daily Race" for events[/url] ( contact us ahoy@marineverse.com for more details )
    [*] Made "Fastest" quality water infinite
    [*] Added Oculus controller models in the multiplayer 
    [*] [b]Game engine update[/b] ( Unity ) - This is actually a big change, if you notice any issues, please let us know on the forum
[/list]

[i]This is a beta update in preparation for cross-play with Oculus Home. Proper 1.1 is expected with future Oculus Home release. If you want, you can opt-in into stable_1_0 branch if you prefer to stay on the old version.[/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l7KtnxppP_U
If you experience any problems or issues with the update, please let us know on the forum and we will try to fix: https://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/1/

Best regards,
MarineVerse team

notes.title: VR Regatta 0.7
notes.content:
Ahoy Friends!

Just pushed an update to VR Regatta. On the surface, it may look like not much have changed (if you ignore those [b]new fancy water reflections[/b]), however quite a lot have changed under the cover.

This update upgrades game engine and some of the major components (for example the one responsible for water simulation) - so if you notice any problems, bugs or performance regression, please contact us support@marineverse.com 

Some of the changes in this version:

[list]
    [*] Experimental [b]wind sound[/b] depending on where the player is looking ( in Tutorial, Race and Long Race)
    [*] Option to [b]attach controller[/b] to Wheel and Tiller ( use grip button instead of trigger)
    [*] [b]Oculus: Using grip[/b] instead of trigger to grab things
    [*] Experimental game progression system ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135509758530163792/ )
    [*] Experimental Player's profile ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135510393195098530/ )
    [*] Performance optimisation: Single pass rendering 
[/list]

As always, looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback :-) ( please contact us via e-mail or comment here )


Best regards,
Greg on behalf of MarineVerse team.

notes.title: VR Regatta 0.7
notes.content:
Ahoy Friends!

Just pushed an update to VR Regatta. On the surface, it may look like not much have changed (if you ignore those [b]new fancy water reflections[/b]), however quite a lot have changed under the cover.

This update upgrades game engine and some of the major components (for example the one responsible for water simulation) - so if you notice any problems, bugs or performance regression, please contact us support@marineverse.com 

Some of the changes in this version:

[list]
    [*] Experimental [b]wind sound[/b] depending on where the player is looking ( in Tutorial, Race and Long Race)
    [*] Option to [b]attach controller[/b] to Wheel and Tiller ( use grip button instead of trigger)
    [*] [b]Oculus: Using grip[/b] instead of trigger to grab things
    [*] Experimental game progression system ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135509758530163792/ )
    [*] Experimental Player's profile ( see http://steamcommunity.com/app/468240/discussions/0/135510393195098530/ )
    [*] Performance optimisation: Single pass rendering 
[/list]

As always, looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback :-) ( please contact us via e-mail or comment here )


Best regards,
Greg on behalf of MarineVerse team.

notes.title: VR Regatta 0.2 - control the mainsail!
notes.content:
Ahoy!

Happy to share that VR Regatta 0.2 just shipped on Steam :-)

New features in this version:
[list]
  [*] Basic mainsail sheet control 
[url=https://twitter.com/MarineVerseVR/status/743785286363058177]Preview[/url]
Should make sailing in race and long race more interesting. All the rankings were cleared as the new control changes the game-play.
  [*] Boom can hit you - watch out for it. 
You asked for it :-) 5s penalty when it happens during Easy Race
  [*] Pay what you want for VR Regatta 
[url=https://twitter.com/MarineVerseVR/status/743783324682903553]Preview[/url]
This is an experiment to see if VR Regatta can be funded only by community donations.
Rather than making you pay upfront for Early Access game, you can decide how much fun you had and if you want more. Donate if you want more :-)
http://store.steampowered.com/buyitem/468240/100/1
[/list]

As always, looking forward to hearing your feedback and ideas on what should we build next. Currently multiplayer is the biggest feature planned in the next release.
